question: What was the role of the University Grants Commission (UGC), established in 1956?

options.text: To oversee and fund higher education institutions in India

solution:
The correct answer is __**To oversee and fund higher education institutions in India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The University Grants Commission (UGC) was established in **1956** under the UGC Act, 1956, to coordinate, determine, and maintain standards of higher education in India.
 
• It is responsible for **overseeing the allocation of funds** to universities and colleges across India and ensuring their proper utilization.
 
• UGC is tasked with **ensuring quality standards** in teaching, examination, and research in higher education institutions.
 
• The commission also **recognizes universities** in India, granting them the authority to confer degrees.
 
• UGC acts as a vital link between the Indian government and higher education institutions to promote the development of higher education in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Autonomy of UGC:**

 
 
• The UGC operates as an autonomous body under the Ministry of Education, Government of India.
 
• It was established to ensure the independence of higher education institutions from political or external influences.
 
 
 
• **Key Functions of UGC:**
 
 
• Monitoring and promoting **research and development** in universities.
 
• Providing fellowships and scholarships to students and researchers.
 
• Advising the government on matters related to higher education.
 
 
 
• **Regional Offices:**
 
 
• UGC has **seven regional offices** across India to ensure efficient coordination and implementation of its policies.
 
• These offices are located in cities like Hyderabad, Pune, Kolkata, and others.
 
 
 
• **National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC):**
 
 
• The UGC established NAAC in 1994 to assess and accredit institutions of higher education to ensure quality standards.
 
• NAAC is an independent body under the aegis of UGC.
 
 
 
• **Revised Roles:**
 
 
• In recent years, UGC has emphasized **skill-based education** and the integration of technology in higher education through initiatives like SWAYAM and MOOCs.
 
• It is actively contributing to the implementation of the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**.
